name: Error Monitoring
shortDescription: Group browser and server errors by root cause and connect each event to the release that produced it.
bestFor: Teams that need actionable JavaScript stack traces without operating a full observability stack
pricingNote: Included with every plan; event volume limits vary by plan
retention: 14 days on Developer, 30 days on Startup, configurable on Enterprise
setup: SDK installation plus a CI source-map upload
features: Groups related browser and server errors into one issue
Associates events with releases and deployment metadata
De-minifies JavaScript stack traces when matching source maps are uploaded
Links an error to correlated logs using a shared trace identifier
limitations: Source maps must be generated and uploaded for de-minified stack traces
Historical events are not reprocessed after a missing source map is uploaded
Native mobile crash reporting is not supported

name: Log Management
shortDescription: Ingest, search, and retain structured application logs with fields preserved for filtering.
bestFor: Small teams consolidating web application and background-job logs
pricingNote: Startup includes 50 GB of ingestion per month
retention: 30 days searchable on Startup; custom retention on Enterprise
setup: Send JSON logs over HTTPS or use a supported framework integration
features: Indexes structured JSON fields for search and filtering
Correlates logs with error events using trace identifiers
Supports saved searches and scheduled log alerts
Exports archived logs to customer-owned object storage
limitations: Full-text indexing is limited to 25 fields per event on Startup
SignalArc does not accept raw packet captures
Archive restore requires an Enterprise plan

name: Distributed Tracing
shortDescription: Follow a request across supported services using OpenTelemetry-compatible trace data.
bestFor: Teams diagnosing latency across a small number of web services and background jobs
pricingNote: Trace ingestion shares the plan's monthly event allowance
retention: 14 days on Startup; custom retention on Enterprise
setup: OpenTelemetry SDK configuration in each traced service
features: Accepts OTLP traces over HTTPS
Connects traces to structured logs and error events
Highlights slow spans and failed downstream calls
Supports service and environment filters
limitations: Tail-based sampling is available only on Enterprise
Profiles and continuous profiling are not supported
Trace completeness depends on instrumentation across every service

name: Uptime Monitoring
shortDescription: Run scheduled HTTP checks from multiple regions and alert when a route fails its policy.
bestFor: Teams that need external availability checks for public web applications and APIs
pricingNote: Developer includes five checks; Startup includes fifty
setup: Create a check with a URL, interval, and expected response
features: Runs checks from three geographic regions
Validates status code, response time, and optional response text
Confirms a failure from a second region before alerting
Publishes check history to a SignalArc status page
limitations: Private-network checks require an Enterprise collector
The shortest check interval is one minute
Browser transaction monitoring is not supported

name: Alert Routing
shortDescription: Route alerts by service and severity to Slack, email, or an on-call escalation policy.
bestFor: Teams replacing a shared alert channel with explicit ownership and escalation
availability: All plans; advanced schedules require Startup
pricingNote: Email and Slack routing are included; phone escalation is billed per user
retention: One year of alert and acknowledgement history
setup: Connect a destination, define service ownership, and test the policy
features: Routes by service, environment, severity, and tag
Groups duplicate alerts during a configurable window
Escalates unacknowledged incidents through an on-call schedule
Records delivery, acknowledgement, and resolution timestamps
limitations: SignalArc does not provide voice-call escalation

name: Status Pages
shortDescription: Publish service health, incident updates, and uptime history on a hosted status page.
bestFor: Software teams that need a simple public incident-communication surface
pricingNote: One public status page is included with Startup
retention: Published incident history is retained while the account is active
setup: Choose services, add a custom domain, and assign incident publishers
features: Displays current status for selected services
Publishes timestamped incident updates
Shows ninety-day uptime history from SignalArc checks
Supports email subscribers
limitations: Uptime history is available only for SignalArc checks
SMS subscriber notifications are not supported
